title: Set your time zone to New Zealand
blurb: Make sure reminders, bookings and scheduled messages run on NZ time.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Business Profile
steps.body: Click **Business Profile** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Enter your address
steps.body: Fill in your street address, city, region and postcode, and set the country to New Zealand.

steps.title: Pick the time zone
steps.body: In the **Time Zone** list, choose **Pacific/Auckland**. It covers all of mainland New Zealand and handles daylight saving on its own.
steps.tip: On the Chatham Islands? Pick Pacific/Chatham instead.

steps.title: Save the section
steps.body: Click the save button at the bottom of this section. Then send yourself a test booking or text to check the times look right.
